requirements:
numpydoc
packaging
mpl_sphinx_theme
sphinxext
docutils
PyYAML
matplotlib
pydata-sphinx-theme
sphinx
numpy
sphinx-gallery
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "import matplotlib; print('Matplotlib build environment ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt converts detected imports to standard PyPI package names (e.g., yaml→PyYAML). Dockerfile uses Python 3.9 slim base, installs dependencies, and includes a health check command. The setup supports matplotlib documentation builds based on detected Sphinx-related imports.
